description: An undefined variable expanded into can's argument makes the call fail
notes: The README says can gives false for an expression that produces errors. The native syntax spec says the expression before ... must evaluate to a list or tuple whose elements are mapped to parameters, and doesn't say whether can's handling of errors covers that expression. hashicorp/hcl evaluates the expanded expression before calling the function and reports its error (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so can never runs.
